observationCompleteness.scopeNote: Completeness applies only to syntactic processing of supplied records; capture coverage and the full FD/module graph are not claimed.

observedPathOperations.interpretation: Rows record path-bearing syscall operations and outcomes only. An open or metadata success does not prove bytes were read or that the path is required.

dependencyAssessment.reason: No static import/asset analysis or controlled removal test is included. Observation alone is not a required-dependency verdict.

userSpaceLoaderSummary.interpretation: Successful module resolution records a resolvable URL, not proof that the module was evaluated or required; process.dlopen results are separate native-load observations.

knownUnobservedPathScopes.scope: Android app-private runtime and data directories
knownUnobservedPathScopes.reason: Both captures ran on Linux; no Android application process or app-private filesystem was present.
The bounded spec supplies the appassets origin only as an HTTP header; neither spec starts WebView or loads a local Android asset URL.
No model/provider request or Android credential-store read is part of these host specs; exact future paths are not asserted.

knownUnobservedPathScopes.scope: Conditional or lazy paths outside the two host test flows
knownUnobservedPathScopes.reason: The specs exercise boot graphs, client batches and selected HTTP checks, not arbitrary user sessions or every optional branch.

knownUnobservedPathScopes.scope: Implementations behind disabled bounded-profile provider rows
knownUnobservedPathScopes.reason: The hashed host-only overlay disables these rows; exact implementation paths are not inferred from their absence in this trace.

additionalLimitations: Only the selected Linux Web-profile test process tree is summarized; raw runner traces remain in the archive.
Initial file descriptors and clone-time descriptor-table sharing are not fully known.
Directory enumeration records do not expose all entries as dependencies.
No path absent from the trace is proven unnecessary; unvisited conditional and lazy paths are not exhaustively enumerable from these runs.
coverageBlindSpots.scopeNote: Examples identify known omissions from this configured host capture, not an exhaustive list of every syscall or path the application could use.

captureMetadata.syscallObservationPass: Uninstrumented Node Web Profile test under strace; test runner is filtered by exact profile PID and descendants.
captureMetadata.moduleObservationPass: Separate test-only Node module.registerHooks/process.dlopen/fs.realpath observer run; its syscalls are not merged into the baseline.
